page.name: Warm Ivory
page.usage: Use for the body background and large quiet surfaces.
avoid: Do not use for cards that need elevation.

wash.name: Warm Wash
wash.usage: Use for alternating section backgrounds, skill chips, and tag fills.
avoid: Do not use for the primary page background.

primary.name: Dark Ink
primary.usage: Use for headings, body text, and high-priority labels.

muted.name: Warm Muted
muted.usage: Use for metadata, captions, helper text, and subdued descriptions.
avoid: Do not use for important claims or metrics.

primary.name: Deep Copper
primary.usage: Use for links, diagnostics, proof, icons, key callouts, metric badges, and CTAs.
avoid: Do not flood large backgrounds with this color.

secondary.name: Light Copper
secondary.usage: Use sparingly for contrast, secondary callouts, and warm emphasis.
avoid: Do not compete with the primary accent.

default.name: Warm Border
default.usage: Use for cards, dividers, tables, and quiet boundaries.

heading.usage: Headings, hero text, pull quotes, and achievement titles.

body.usage: Body text, labels, tags, metadata, and navigation.

principles: Use semantic CSS variables, not hard-coded colors.
Use primary accent for proof, diagnostics, links, icons, key callouts, and metric badges.
Cards should look obviously clickable: border, hover state, full-card link target.
For v0-generated UI, normalize colors back to semantic CSS variables before merging.
Prefer shared component polish over page-local one-off styling.
